 Print NICL AO Prelims 2026: Admit card released, check login details, vacancy distribution and exam instructions NICL AO Admit Card 2026 : The National Insurance Company Limited (NICL) has released the Administrative Officer (AO) Prelims Admit Card 2026 on November 10. Candidates who applied for the recruitment of 321 Administrative Officers (Generalists and Specialists) Scale I posts can download their call letters from the official website, nationalinsurance.nic.co.in. The preliminary examination is scheduled to take place on November 17, 2026. The recruitment covers multiple disciplines, including Generalist, Legal, Finance, Information Technology, Automobile Engineering, Risk Engineering, Company Secretary and Agriculture. Candidates must log in using their registration number or roll number and password or date of birth to access the admit card. The download facility will remain available until November 17.  How to download NICL AO call letter 2026
 Candidates can follow these steps to download their preliminary examination admit cards: Step 1: Visit the official NICL website. Step 2: Open the Administrative Officer recruitment admit card link. Step 3: Select English or Hindi as the preferred language. Step 4: Enter the registration number or roll number. Step 5: Provide the password or date of birth in DD-MM-YY format. Step 6: Enter the security captcha and click Login. Step 7: Check the examination details displayed on the screen. Step 8: Download the call letter and take a printout. Direct link to check and download the NICL AO Admit Card 2026 
 Documents required for the examination Candidates must carry a printed copy of the admit card and an original, valid photo identity document to the examination centre. They should verify their name, roll number, examination date, reporting time and centre address before appearing for the test. NICL AO selection process The selection process comprises a preliminary online objective examination carrying 100 marks, followed by a mains examination consisting of a 250-mark objective test and a 30-mark descriptive test. Shortlisted candidates will subsequently undergo a personal interview, document verification and medical examination.
